spec.event: 非人的旧金权柄线把彼此矛盾的历史回廊、星体概念与完整神国折叠到同一条现在；金线在帷幕处收束，微小无面身份残影只作尺度参照。

task.prompt: Use case: concept-card-candidate. Create ONE complete upright Fool pathway Sequence 0 character card at the tool's native 2:3 canvas. Image 1 is the authority-first full-bleed scene source: preserve its old-gold law seam, deep smoky-violet curtain divide, warm historical city and observatory echoes on the left, cold suspended corridors and starless depth on the right, and tiny faceless identity residue near the seam. Image 2 is the current Fool true-god frame geometry and material reference. Image 3 is the accepted Sequence 0 full-card identity/style reference. The final output must be one coherent card, not a collage: let the scene naturally meet the inner frame edges while keeping the true-god orange-gold frame, smoky-violet inlays, Fool crown, top circular rank dock with an upright artistic 0, left vertical 愚者 pathway name, right vertical 愚者 sequence name, bottom existing name surface, and one embedded golden-amber equilateral-hexagonal gemstone visually stable and legible. Engrave the exact character name 愚者先生 as one elegant artistic inscription inside the existing bottom name surface only; center by actual strokes horizontally and vertically, large but contained, no added plaque, no opaque text background, no duplicate or mirrored text. The authority seam and folded histories are the single dominant event: nonhuman rule-space and complete mystical realm carry about 85 percent of the visual weight, while the faceless human-scale residue remains under 15 percent and is not a portrait. Preserve coherent depth, old gold, smoky violet, cool silver and restrained midnight blue with sharp engraved-detail material quality; make the amber gemstone faceted, deep, translucent and locally brilliant rather than a white blob. No inner-scene text, letters, numbers, labels, handwriting, pseudo-writing, watermark, extra person, recognizable face, throne, idol, crown inside the scene, wings, tentacles, magic-circle diagram, generic spell beam, modern object, repeated frame, pasted panel, hard photo boundary or split-screen seam. Do not redesign the frame, move the rank dock, enlarge the crown, add gemstones, recolor the entire scene, or change the 2:3 upright composition. Output one complete native card candidate; the bottom name is 愚者先生, while the right-side sequence name remains 愚者.
